## Summary

A short, one-line description of the feature.

## Problem / motivation

What problem does this solve, or what workflow does it enable?

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature you'd like. If relevant, include:
- Which tool category it belongs to (scene, rendering, image-to-3D, …)
- What the MCP tool name and parameters might look like
- Any external API or dependency it would require

## Alternatives considered

Are there existing tools or workarounds? Why aren't they sufficient?

## Additional context

Any mockups, references, or related issues.
